brief: Holds labelled examples, each a list of numbers and a label, in the form every learner of the learning module trains from.
detail: A training set is built from [ features, label ] pairs or filled one example at a time. Labels are kept as text. Split is a deterministic head and tail cut and never shuffles, so a run can be repeated exactly; order the examples yourself first when a shuffle is wanted. The learners (stzKnn, stzNaiveBayes, stzDecisionTree, stzLogisticRegression, stzNeuralNetwork) and stzTrainer take a set of this kind.
